name: click
description: Choose Always ON or Manual mode once; Manual uses @Click. Compile software changes into one compact approval-bound execution contract with a plain-language explanation, block observable implementation loops, and run one automatically budgeted final verification batch.

interface.shortDescription: Approve once, then implement the contract in one shot.
interface.longDescription: Click asks once whether software changes should use Always ON (recommended) or Manual mode. Always ON applies one compact contract and one approval before supported software mutations; Manual applies the same workflow only when @Click is selected. Questions, explanations, and simple read-only inspection remain normal. Code review needs no build contract, but its read-only guard blocks repeated successful matched shell observations, repeat repository-wide inventory, replanning churn, and mutations. After approval Click implements in one shot while the Hook blocks replacement contracts, observable implementation loops, and verification outside the automatically selected budget. Necessary in-scope implementation details remain flexible. The bundled Fix skill provides the same compact repair flow for direct invocation.
defaultPrompt: Use Click to create one compact developer execution contract, choose and automatically budget a verification scale, explain it plainly, and ask once before implementation.
Use Click to design and implement this change in one approved shot, blocking observable tool loops and using one final verification batch.
Set Click to Always ON for software changes while keeping questions and read-only inspection normal.
Use Click's read-only review guard to review this code without repeated repository scans.
Use Fix to translate this bug report into a compact repair contract and ask once before repairing it.
